## 🎬 Neron H3 Story — прототип / prototype

**RU**
1. **LoadImage** — первый кадр ролика. Он же образец внешности (🔒 включено).
2. Три текста — по одному на блок. Каждый следующий пиши как **продолжение** прошлого.
3. Сначала гоняй в **⚡ Турбо** — проверить стыки. Потом **Качество**.
4. Блоки 2 и 3 начинаются с хвоста прошлого блока (≈0,9 с) **вместе со звуком** — стык не должен быть виден.
5. Время ≈ прогон H3 Engine × число блоков. Замеров этой ноды ещё нет.

Что смотреть на тесте: рывок на стыке (≈10 и ≈19 с), обрыв звука, не поменялись ли лица и одежда.

**EN**
LoadImage = first frame and appearance sample. One text per block, each continues the previous one. Test in Turbo first. Blocks 2+ continue the previous tail (~0.9 s) with its sound. Check seams, sound and faces.

nodes.title: Блок 1 / Block 1
widgets_values: The main subject from the first frame starts moving: at about the first second it turns its head slowly to the left, at the third second it takes a calm step forward, by the sixth second it walks steadily across the scene, the camera follows smoothly at the same height. Natural light, soft ambient sound of the place, footsteps, no music.

nodes.title: Блок 2 / Block 2
widgets_values: The main subject keeps walking in the same direction without stopping, at about the third second it slows down and looks back over its shoulder, at the sixth second it stops and turns to face the camera, a light breeze moves hair and fabric. Same light, same ambient sound, footsteps fade, no music.

nodes.title: Блок 3 / Block 3
widgets_values: The main subject stands facing the camera, at about the second second it smiles gently, at the fourth second it raises one hand in a short greeting, then lowers it and stays still until the end, the camera slowly moves a little closer. Same light, quiet ambient sound, no music.
